description: The worker contract should consume an embedding execution plan and locate its planned completion stubs and batch records without calling an embedding provider.
Every sampled stored vector row should preserve embedding id, subject id, batch id, profile id, text hash, dimensions, and expected dimensions from the plan.
Contract rows should be clearly marked as contract stubs so they cannot be mistaken for production semantic vectors or loaded into tenant-visible search.
The sampled completion rows and stored vector metadata rows should pass the vector readiness audit with no missing, mismatched, or orphan rows.
